faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Salem recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the DCPU Salem recruitment is 12 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated office by 5:30 PM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for various posts, including Assistant cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant, under the District Child Protection Unit, Salem.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have passed the VIII (Class 8) examination from any recognized State or Private School Board to be eligible for the selection process.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the DCPU Salem recruitment. Candidates can submit their applications without any payment requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts mentioned in the DCPU Salem recruitment notification is 42 years. There is no minimum age specified in the official document.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- as per the official recruitment notification provided by the organization.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for multiple posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for the posts, but they are required to fill out separate application forms for each post they wish to apply for, as per the official instructions.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The filled-in application form along with the necessary self-attested documents must be sent to the District Child Protection Office, Salem, before the deadline of 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the recruitment for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant, and Office Assistant posts in the District Child Protection Unit, Salem, is purely on a temporary basis.
